_about: Settings for the fact sheets (engine/profiles/: build.py, walk_grid.py, fetch_walk.py, fetch_drive.py, page.html): one per Analysis Neighborhood. 'The subway' here is BART and Muni Metro together (metro: BART's stations and every Muni Metro stop, surface stops included, from muni_metro_stops.geojson, which only the fact sheets read); stops and changes to the hubs are counted along each drawn line, with a change wherever two stations sit within 200 m (Montgomery's BART and Muni platforms). factsheet.css colours the line bullets in the map's own BART and Muni palette. 'transfers' adds the passage between Union Square/Market St (the T Third) and Powell Street, about 300 m. Lines come from metro_lines.geojson, each line's main GTFS shapes whole (the map's own line files are in short pieces).

page.description: Printable one-page fact sheets for each of San Francisco’s 41 Analysis Neighborhoods: BART and Muni Metro, buses, freeways, drive times, City parking, EV charging, parks, libraries and Bay Wheels. Drop a pin for walk and drive times from any spot.
